name: Phone controls
summary: Let your assistant open apps, set alarms and timers, use the flashlight, control music and volume, start calls, texts and emails for you to send, and more.

tools.name: phone.status
tools.description: Gets the phone's battery level, whether it is charging, the network, free storage, model, Android version and the local time.

tools.name: apps.list
tools.description: Lists the apps installed on the phone, optionally filtered by a word in the name.

tools.name: apps.open
tools.description: Opens an app on the phone by its name, for example Camera, Chrome or WhatsApp. Only works while Pocketnode is on the screen.

name.description: The app's name as shown on the home screen

tools.name: phone.flashlight
tools.description: Turns the phone's flashlight on or off.

on.description: true for on (default), false for off

tools.name: phone.media
tools.description: Plays, pauses or skips the music or video that is playing in another app, or changes the volume. It controls whatever player is active; it cannot choose a song.

tools.name: phone.alarm
tools.description: Sets an alarm at a time of day in the clock app.

tools.name: phone.timer
tools.description: Starts a countdown timer in the clock app.

tools.name: phone.call
tools.description: Opens the phone dialer with a number filled in. The owner presses the call button; nothing is dialled automatically.

tools.name: phone.text
tools.description: Opens a text message to a number with the words filled in. The owner presses send; nothing is sent automatically.

tools.name: phone.email
tools.description: Opens an email with the recipient, subject and body filled in. The owner presses send; nothing is sent automatically.

tools.name: phone.share
tools.description: Opens the share sheet with some text, so the owner can send it to any app, such as a notes app, Keep, or a chat.

tools.name: phone.open_link
tools.description: Opens a web address in the phone's browser.

tools.name: phone.map
tools.description: Opens a place or search in the maps app. Set directions to true when the owner asks how to get there: the maps app then shows a route from where the phone is.

directions.description: True to open directions to the place instead of showing it on the map

tools.name: phone.notify
tools.description: Shows a notification on the phone with a title and text, for example as a reminder.

tools.name: phone.speak
tools.description: Reads some text out loud through the phone's speaker.

tools.name: phone.copy
tools.description: Copies text to the clipboard so the owner can paste it anywhere.
